# REGISTRO

A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:


1. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial;
2. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;
3. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 25,00 pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Conta para deposito: Banco Itau | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. O comprovante deve ser enviado ao email dos organizadores para aprovação da inscrição.
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail antonio.cecchini@gmail.com e vicenzo.g.cecchini@gmail.com

------------

**REGISTRATION**

The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:

1.	Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
2.	Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
3.	Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 (registration+shirt) paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed.
Bank Account:  Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01.
4.	For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizers via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com and vicenzo.g.cecchini@gmail.com)

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: CubingZA Cape Cubes Autumn 2023

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)
venue.address: 18 Lente St, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, 7945, South Africa

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the second Cape Town competition for 2023. This competition will take on a "Big & Weird" theme on Saturday, with bigger NxN cubes and some side events not often held in Cape Town, with a more familiar event structure on Sunday! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/208588-cubingza-cape-cubes-autumn-2023/#/) page.

### SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### SPONSORSHIP
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png)
A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

### LUCKY DRAW

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information:
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor.
Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.**
You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 22 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 21:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one.

Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.
Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.**
Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 22 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 21:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.information:
## Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before April 1, 2023 at 7:00 PM EDT.

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

items.name: Rahn Education Leipzig 2023
items.information:
**Deutsch**

Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur ersten Competition in **Leipzig** in der Geschichte der WCA. Nach über 12 Jahren findet endlich wieder eine Competition in Sachsen statt und wir, das Orga-Team freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig und ein motiviertes Orga-Team. Lasst uns gemeinsam dafür sorgen, dass die Competition **Rahn Education Leipzig** ein traditionelles Event in der WCA wird. 

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**


**English**

We cordially invite you to the first competition in **Leipzig** in the history of the WCA. After more than 12 years, there is finally a competition in Saxony and we, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. You can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig and a motivated organizational team. Let's work together to ensure that the **Rahn Education Leipzig** competition becomes a traditional event in the WCA.

**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Fasching 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the Vienna Fasching 2023 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information:
## Waterloo Favourites 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Waterloo Favourites A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WaterlooFavouritesA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before February 4, 2023 at 7:00 PM EST.

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

Välkommen till första tävlingen någonsin i Kalmar! Vi påminner om att alla är varmt välkomna, vare sig du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi rekommenderar att du läser all information på sidan så du inte missar någon viktig information.

Tävlingen är schemalagd så att om du inte deltar i Megaminx, 5x5, 6x6 eller 7x7 så behöver du inte vara närvarande förrän 14:05 på lördagen.

Vi har också tyvärr fått sätta en gräns på ***en gäst per person*** eftersom lokalen inte är så stor.

**English**
Welcome to the competition ever in Kalmar! We remind you that everyone is welcome, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We recommend that you read all the information on this page to not miss any important information.

The competition is scheduled so that if you don’t compete in Megaminx, 5x5, 6x6 or 7x7, you won’t have to be present until 2:05 PM on Saturday.

We have also unfortunately had to set a limit of ***one guest per person***  because the venue is quite small.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png)
# 🇺🇾
Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 35.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

Este open será un test para competiciones similares, en las que cada competidor realizará medias en los eventos que quiera en el orden que quiera. Para participar, a parte de registrarse en le WCA, es necesario rellenar el [siguiente formulario](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66), y asistir a los dos grupos, de inicio a fin. Más información en la pestaña de FUNCIONAMIENTO DE LA COMPETICIÓN.

OHARRA: Zure lehen lehiaketa bada, aurretik ['lehiaketa arrunt'](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) batera joatea gomendatzen dizugu. Open hau antzeko lehiaketetarako test bat izango da, lehiakide bakoitzak nahi dituen ekitaldietako batez bestekoak egingo ditu nahi duen ordenan. Parte hartzeko ezinbestekoa da [formulario hau](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66) betetzea, eta bi taldeetan egon, hasieratik amaierara. Informazio gehiago LEHIAKETAREN FUNTZIONAMENDUA erlaitzean.

WARNING: If you're a new competitor, we recommend you attend a ['normal' competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) first. This competition will be a test, in which each competitor will do their averages in the order they want. To participate at this competition, it is mandatory to fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66), and also attend both groups. More information at the HOW WILL THE COMPETITION WORK tab.

items.name: Athens Winter Open 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2N0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--83fc6c836b78e431cd8e0d013efd6be412a6e388/IMG_9500.JPG)
Athens Winter Open 2023 είναι ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα , ύστερα από μία πολλά υποσχόμενη χρονιά. Στις επόμενες διοργανώσεις, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 διοργανώσεις που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστές στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 6x6 και του 7x7 πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλες οι εκδηλώσεις θα είναι οικείες στους συμμετέχοντες.

Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή για το cubing γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείτε ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca και να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 


Athens Winter Open 2023 is the first competition this year in Greece, following a very successfull year of competitions.
In the next competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 6x6 and 7x7 closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors.

Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the eca site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

**OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag.

--

A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

**N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.
Esta competição será realizada em um formato diferente do tradicional, neste campeonato, os competidores terão uma hora de limite para fazer todos os eventos que quiserem na ordem em que desejarem. Em um grupo serão juízes, no outro, competidores e em outro, embaralhadores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners
This competition will happen in a format different from the traditional, at this competition, the competitors will have an hour to do all the events they want in the order they want. In a group they will be judges, on the other, competitors and in a last one, scramblers.

Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule).
En raison de la situation sanitaire, les conditions d'accès à la compétition peuvent changer au gré des annonces gouvernementales. L'équipe d'organisation vous informera des restrictions en vigueur à chaque changement.

Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;

## Appleby Winter 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Appleby Winter A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApplebyWinterA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminder

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

## No Food or Drink

Appleby College does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the gymnasium or off-site.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information:
Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen.

### Vänligen notera:
* **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).**
* **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information.
* **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret.
* **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.**

---

Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition.

### Please note: 
* **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).**
* **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information.
* **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office.
* **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни).
В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады.

1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес.

2. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде).
Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Please see our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link).  All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram.

 1. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings.

 2. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them.

items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. 11/3に行われる[Ayase Autumn A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnA2022) (以下、A大会) と11/6に行われるAyase Autumn B 2022 (**本大会 / 以下、B大会**) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。
### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。
A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 3x3x3 目隠し / スクエア1 / スキューブ / クロック / 3x3x3複数 目隠し
**B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 5x5x5 キューブ / 6x6x6 キューブ / メガミンクス (2ラウンド)**

新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。
飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。

会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。
競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。**
また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。

###会場についての注意###
今回の会場は集会室1,2共に**靴を脱いで**利用する部屋となります。そのため、衛生上の観点から競技者及び見学者の方は**靴下の着用**をお願いします。

[Ayase Autumn A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnA2022) (A) and Ayase Autumn B 2022 (**This competition, B**) are WCA Series Competitions. 
### You can register either of these competitions.  
If you register for multiple competitions, the earliest one will only be received, and the others will be rejected.

Please make sure that the events for A and B are different.
A: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 3x3x3 blindfolded / Square-1 / Skewb / Clock / 3x3x3 Multi-Blind
**B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 5x5x5 Cube / 6x6x6 Cube / Megaminx (2 round)**

The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure.
**Only the companions of competitors are allowed to enter the venue as spectators.**
Being mindful of space, we can only accept requests of  **1 companion at MAX per competitor.**

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information:
## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022!
### This year's UK National Championship


##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab.

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size.

**Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition.

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**.

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022.

We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes.

**Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

[![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

venue.details: Torvalla Sporthall. Enter using the combined entrance to the swimming hall, then follow the signs.

items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022).

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare.

*Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!*

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022).

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

*Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

venue.name: Amrita School of Engineering, Amritapuri Campus
venue.address: Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita University Main Rd, Amritapuri, Vallikkavu, Kollam, Kerala - 690525

items.information:
![](https://i.imgur.com/Upxb5EP.png)

Why SILENCE?

We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :)

We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure.

We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it.

We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. 
  
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. 
 
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

Happy cubing!

NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19.
Hay un límite de 50 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* Se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Leer toda la información disponible en esta página.

Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. 

# 🇬🇧
YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF COVID-19.
Competitor limit: 50.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.

A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)).
* Competitors must provide their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdnNZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5dab4db532469b133dcb4913ae4f07994fbe1f39/LOGO_MP22_pro.png)

Mistrzostwa Polski w Speedcubingu to najważniejsza impreza sezonu w kalendarzu każdego polskiego speedcubera. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach World Cube Association.

Po niezwykle udanej edycji 2021 Mistrzostwa Polski ponownie zostaną przeprowadzone w miejscu wyjątkowym jakim jest Olivia Star! Poraz kolejny rywalizacji na najwyższym poziomie będą towarzyszyły niesamowite widoki 34 piętra Olivia Star - największego wieżowca w północnej Polsce!

---

Polish Speedcubing Championship is the most important event of the year of every Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it continues to attract best competitors who compete for national titles in all events sanctioned by World Cube Association.

After successful 2021 edition this year's championship will be held in a special place - Olivia Star! Once again competing at the highest level will be accompanied by amazing views from 34th floor of Olivia Star building - highest scyscraper in northern Poland!

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2022! Dette er den første kube konkuransen i Oslo siden 2015! Vi gleder oss!
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet.

Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015!

items.name: UBC Side Events 2022
items.information:
* **Regular 3x3 will not be held at this competition**.
* If you are **not** competing in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind in the morning then you do **not** need to show up until after lunch (but coming anyway to help out would be appreciated).
* All competitors will be **expected to help out** in order for the event to run smoothly.
* Cutoffs, advancement conditions, and event start times may change depending on registration totals - any changes will be emailed out to registered competitors in advance.

###As per UBC's rules, masks will be required at this competition. 

However, due to the recent changes to BC Public Health Order, we will not be seeking the proof of vaccination status of competitors and guests. As an expected and still valuable courtesy, we simply ask that those experiencing any COVID-19 like symptoms or those with a recent positive COVID-19 test refrain from attending. Competitors may arrange with the organisational team for a full refund if they need to opt out due to the onset of illness or a positive test. Naturally we have a COVID-19 Information tab here on the website to share any useful considerations pertaining to personal wellness at the competition and as a place to communicate any additional changes to the new health order - if the government re-introduces restrictions such as proof of vaccination, we will update the website and email registered competitiors.

Registration with a $22 CDN payment through Stripe opens Friday May 13th 5:00pm PDT.

Note that registration will close two weeks later. No on the spot registrations will be accepted.
Registration is first come, first served based on the order of when payment through Stripe is received.
A waitlist will be maintained for those unable to secure a spot in the competition.

BY REGISTERING, YOU AGREE THAT YOU UNDERSTAND AND WILL FOLLOW ALL OF THE HEALTH AND SAFETY MEASURES LISTED IN THE HEALTH AND SAFETY (COVID) TAB AND ACCEPT THAT ANY OF THE MEASURES MAY NEED TO BE CHANGED CLOSER TO THE DATE OF THE COMPETITION.

Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we require that each competitor bring at most 1 guest.

items.name: Arnold Classic Africa 2022
items.information:
### General Information

This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that due to the nature of the festival the venue will be extremely noisy, and this is outside of our control. The competition will be taking place in a large tent, and it is June, so dress warmly.

### Competitor Tickets

Please register for the competition and select your events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldClassicAfrica2022/register), and then pay for your registration at:
https://www.quicket.co.za/events/175059-speed-cubing-arnold-classic-africa/#/
Tickets for competitors cost R200, which includes access to the rest of the expo and sport festival.


### Guests

Spectators are welcome, but will need to pay for entrance to the expo. Tickets can be bought online through [WebTickets](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420) or paid for at the door. Various pricing options are available depending on whether you wish to attend for the whole weekend or just one day.
**[Tickets for guests](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420)**

### Volunteering

We will require volunteers to support with running and judging on the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact the organisers. Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing.

items.information:
[FR]

En accord avec la politique de santé publique et les directives de l'ÉTS, tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront porter un masque à l'intérieur des bâtiments. Le port du couvre-visage en tissu est interdit. Dans l'éventualité où les directives changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.

Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet Santé & Sécurité.

**Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, vous devez réserver votre place sur le [portail de réservation](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) dans monÉTS dans la section "Activités de la vie étudiante". Vous devez enregistrer au plus tard le vendredi 15 avril à 15h. Une fois que c'est fait j'aurais la liste des étudiants qui n'auront pas besoin de payer. Vous devez donc ensuite vous inscrire sur le site web WCA en même temps que tout le monde, simplement vous n'aurez pas à payer les frais d'inscription. Je précise que vous devez enregister le plus tôt possible, car être enregistré sur le portail de réservation ne vous garantie pas une place dans la compétition.

Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée.

[EN]

As per the current public health policy and the directives of the university, all competitors and their guest must wear a mask at all time inside the buildings. Wearing a cloth mask is prohibited. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the regulations change. 

Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab.

**ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, you must reserve your place on the [reservation portal](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) on monÉTS in the "Activités de la vie étudiante" section. You must register there by Friday, April 15 at 15h. Once you register there I will have the list of students who do not need to pay. You can then register on the WCA site without paying the fee. You should register as quickly as possible, as being registered on the monÉTS portal does not guarantee you a place in the competition.

There will be **no refunds in case of cancellation** (due to transaction fees) . However, if you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

items.name: Oficina Open 2022
items.information:
# REGISTRO

A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:

1.	Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição;
2.	Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial;
3.	Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;
4.	Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 25,00 (inscrição+camiseta) pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato.
Conta para deposito: Banco Itau | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01.
5.	Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org).

O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou  teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. Essas regras podem ser mais restritas ou flexibilizadas conforme orientações dos órgãos governamentais até a data do evento.

------------

**REGISTRATION**

The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:

1.	Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer;
2.	Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
3.	Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
4.	Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 (registration+shirt) paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed.
Bank Account:  Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01.
5.	For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), or the delegate via email  (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org).

Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. These rules may be changed to be more restrictive or flexible based upon governmental mandates until the event date.

**Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb

Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis.

Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. 

All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:

1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

OR

2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Monday, March 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.

**Refund Information: Due to venue financial requirements, no refunds will be issued after March 3rd, 2022 unless there are extreme circumstances. These circumstances include the following: **
* **Competitor contracts COVID-19 within 14 days of the competition and must withdraw**
* **Other Injury or Sickness that would prevent the competitor from attending**
* **Competition as a whole is cancelled**
* **Any specific excuse deemed acceptable by an organizer or delegate**
**We understand that some may need to cancel their registration after the refund date due to unforseen events or circumstances; however, due to financial constraints, we will only be refunding competitors if they meet one of the previously mentioned conditions. We thank you for your understanding.**

# Denna tävling har ställts in på grund av förändrade COVID-19 restriktioner.

#### English
# This competition has been cancelled due to a change in COVID-19 restrictions.

Welcome to Uppsala Open 2022, a cozy one day competition in Stenhagen, Uppsala. This is the first time a competition is held in Uppsala in 7 years!
Do not forget to read all of the tabs for important information regarding the competition.
*You may choose to compete either in 6x6/7x7, or 4bld/5bld. 4bld and 5bld will be held at the side stage, at the same time as 6x6 and 7x7.*

تفاصيل المسابقة :- المسابقة في قاعة في الطابق الأرضي في مدرسة الحكمة الثانوية للبنين، شارع الاستقلال، بالقرب من الاستقلال مول،. كما هو موضح في العنوان في الأعلى👆.

يمكنك الدخول إلى القاعة من المدخل الخلفي، عند مكان تجمع حافلات المدرسة.

يرجى العلم بأن المسابقة ستكون لمدة يومين و الايفنتات مقسمة على مدة يومين كما هو موضح في الجدول. 

( في حال رغبتكم بالمشاركة في ايفنتات اليوم الثاني فقط يرجى العلم بأنه سيتم فتح التسجيل في كلا اليومين فلا داعي للحضور لمجرد التسجيل في اليوم الأول)

اذا كان لديك اي استفسار او سؤال عن تفاصيل المسابقة، يرجى التواصل من خلال الايميل في الأعلى، أو من خلال صفحة Jordan cubing community عبر تطبيق Instagram.

items.information:
Popping Off Pukekohe B 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

Please note this is a **twin competition**. To make it fairer and more accessible to more competitiors during the current covid-19 restrictions, you will only be allowed to register for one competition - not both. Please check the event list and timings to see which day you would like to register for as there will be different events on different days.

# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:
##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, January 1st is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
##### **OR**

#### 
##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted.

items.name: Güemes Open 2022
items.information:
Güemes Open 2022 es la primera competencia que se va a realizar en la provincia de Salta, Argentina, y a su vez, la primera competencia del 2022 del país! 
El objetivo de esta competencia es reactivar la comunidad norteña del país.
Nos esforzaremos en hacer cumplir todos los protocolos pertinentes a la pandemia.
Competidores, recuerden ser puntuales, siguiendo los horarios del cronograma. Recomendamos llegar 20 minutos antes para evitar inconvenientes, en especial a los nuevos competidores.
Este torneo contará con 11 categorias oficiales y tendrá una duración de 2 días.

Güemes Open 2022 is the first competition to be held in the province of Salta, Argentina, and also, the first competition of 2022 in the country!

**Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**.

Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA.

Note : **un (1) accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir.

Note : Dans le cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA annule la compétition. Les mises à jour importantes seront affichées sur ce site et envoyées directement par courriel aux compétiteurs.

**[EN]**

**As per the Quebec government's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www.quebec.ca/en/health/health-issues/a-z/2019-coronavirus/progress-of-the-covid-19-vaccination/covid-19-vaccination-passport/places-and-activities-requiring-covid-19-vaccination-passport), all competitors and their (single) guest must present a valid proof of vaccination and a valid piece of ID with photo in order to enter the venue. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the government updates its regulations.** Moreover, note that **individuals arriving from outside of Canada need to qualify as [fully vaccinated travellers](https://travel.gc.ca/travel-covid/travel-restrictions/covid-vaccinated-travellers-entering-canada) and follow the canadian government policies detailed on the website.**

Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing).

items.information:
# This competition has been cancelled.

# The date for this competition has changed to August 20-21, 2021. Please familiarize yourself with the [Safety Plan] (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vgSyWUwrL1MkixikzJqiZXodSBejV2S39T_18PCm5-E/edit).

1. If COVID-19 cases drop to below 10 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue as announced.
2. If COVID-19 cases are between 10 and 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue, but all attendees (spectators and competitors) must show either proof of full vaccination (2 weeks since last shot of 1 or 2 dose series) or have a negative COVID-19 test within 96 hours of the beginning of the event, or after 8:00am Eastern on Monday, August 16th, 2021. There are no exceptions. 
3. If COVID-19 cases are greater than 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will not continue and we will either reschedule or cancel at that time.


# Maximum one spectator per competitor. 
## This competition’s registration and waitlist is full.


We are very excited to announce the inaugural Pennsylvania Championship! Join us for a very sweet weekend of cubing and fun in historic Hershey Pennsylvania. We will have two special unofficial events as well as the option to have a day at HersheyPark on Sunday with all of your friends.

This is the state championship for Pennsylvania, however, anyone can attend. All state champion titles are unofficial and are **not** recognized by the World Cube Association or CubingUSA. For more information on state champion eligibility, see the [PA Title eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2021#14358-pa-title-eligibility).

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations
Live results can be found on our WCA Live page, which will be available during the competition.
Before registering, you must read the "Competitor Information" tab. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition.

Day 1 Events: Pyraminx, Clock, Megaminx, 3x3 Blindfolded, 6x6, 7x7, Sq-1, FMC
Day 2 Events: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 One Handed

**This competition is sponsored by TheCubicle!**
Visit the [Sponsor/Vending](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2021#14359-sponsor-vending) tab for more information.

items.name: Copper Country Cubing Summer 2021

venue.name: [MTU Memorial Union Building](https://www.mtu.edu/memorialunion/)
venue.address: Memorial Union Building, 1400 Townsend Dr, Houghton, MI 49931

items.information:
This is the fourth Copper Country Cubing competition, and we're looking forward to welcoming you to the Michigan Upper Peninsula! It's been a long time since anyone has been able to compete, so this event features two long events on Saturday evening and the more common NxN events on Sunday. We plan to host another competition this Fall with more of the non-NxN puzzles, so look out for it!

As this competition takes place on the Michigan Technology University campus, it is subject to Michigan state laws, University campus policies, and WCA policies. We will monitor all of these sources for any changes to safety protocols and requirements. Please note that if community or regional health problems surface again or severely worsen, the competition may be forced to cancel. 

There is a 40 person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please sign up early to ensure a spot, and please read the "Waiting List" tab for additional information on registration for the competition.

If the competition is running ahead of schedule and has enough competitors we would love to add an additional round to 3BLD, 3OH, and/or 6x6. Additionally, please note that the rounds are scheduled with more time than usual to account for stationary groups and sanitation time.

**YOU MUST READ THE COVID SAFETY TAB PRIOR TO REGISTERING.**

## Konkurrencen er aflyst pga. COVID-19 udbruddet.
Dette er 2. version af Aarhus Spring! Efter selve konkurrencen er færdig om søndagen er der generalforsamling i vores lokalforening Speedcubing Aarhus, som man er meget velkommen til at deltage i.

-  3x3x3 Med Fødderne
-  3x3x3 Team-Blind.

Vi tilbyder billig [overnatning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2020#14284-overnatning-accommodation).

___
## The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns.

Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia.

---------------------------------------------------------------

Registration is open to all, of all nationalities.

Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few.

Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.information:
**English:**
CubingAT is happy to announce the first official WCA competition in Salzburg, the Salzburg Open 2020. Fortunately, we found a very strong, dynamic and cool partner (HTBLuVA Salzburg), that finally gave us the possibility to solve some cubes in Salzburg.
The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations.

All guests are welcome, but to maintain the security, we would like you to let us know you’re coming. Simply write us your name to this e-mail address: competitions@cubing.at. Alternatively, if you accompany a competitor, they can write your name in the comment of their registration.
___
**Deutsch:**
Wir von CubingAT freuen uns sehr euch in der HTBLuVA Salzburg, bei den ersten Salzburg Open 2020 begrüßen zu können. Dank der hervorragenden Zusammenarbeit mit dem routinierten, dynamischen und vor allem aufgeschlossenen Team der HTBLuVA, dürfen wir Speedcuber auch endlich mal in Salzburg Würfel (schnell) lösen. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben.

Alle Gäste sind selbstverständlich gerne willkommen, jedoch würden wir euch aus Sicherheitsgründen bitten, uns ein kurzes Mail mit eurem Namen unter der E-Mail competitions@cubing.at zukommen zu lassen. Oder, falls Ihr einen Teilnehmer begleitet, kann Euer Name bei dessen Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld vermerkt werden.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information:
Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve.
Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition.
**Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.**

**REPAS** :
Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition.
Samedi soir, pour 10€ : 
* Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser)
* Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau

Dimanche soir pour 15€ : 
* Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J)
* Un dessert, comme le samedi

**LASER GAME** :
Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€.
Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! 

---
You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event.
We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition.
**Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.**

**DINNERS**:
On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue.
Saturday evening for 10€:
* "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us)
* A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake

Sunday evening for 15€:
* A big pizza (to be chosen on the day)
* A dessert, like on Saturday

**LASER GAME**:
On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€.
Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

The requirements are as follows: 3x3x3 with Feet - 4 UK competitors; 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3x3 Cube - 8 UK competitors.

**Please Note**: As this is the UK Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

items.information:
Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna auto-sustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.
